summary: Phase 3.9 SDK Regeneration + React Evidence UI acceptance gate PASSED. All seven SDK consistency tests are green (zero-drift), constitutional DDD suite (Phase 1 identity, Registry, Evidence, Phase 3.6/3.7/3.8, contract freeze, SDK consistency) is 192/192 green, Phase 3.8 projections still 17/17 (no regression). Evidence Workspace UI loads cleanly at /evidence with the exact SDK badge text 'SDK 1.5.0+sdk.1 · contract 1.5.0', brand 'LandVault' + 'Evidence Bounded Context', side nav (List/Upload/Projections), working skip-to-main link, and all WCAG 2.2 AA features (table caption sr-only, th scope=col×5, aria-busy, aria-live=polite on upload progress, lucide icons (no emoji), focus rings amber-400, semantic <label> wrapping). Constitutional purity confirmed: zero fetch/axios/XMLHttpRequest/lib/api imports in pages/evidence/*.jsx — only useSdk + sonner + lucide-react + react-router-dom + react. EvidenceUpload does NOT compute SHA-256 client-side — it forwards server-computed receipt.streamed_sha256 to /complete. Full super_admin E2E succeeded: register → mongo promote → re-login → localStorage.lv_session_token → /evidence renders 20+ items, detail page renders all 7 tabs (Overview/Timeline/Seal/Integrity/Custody/Versions/Legal Hold), /evidence/admin/projections lists evidence.timeline with engine status and Snapshot+Replay buttons both functional.
critical_code_review_comments: EvidenceUpload.jsx ProgressBoard is conditionally rendered (only when `stage` is set). This is intentional and correct, but for testing convenience consider also surfacing `data-testid=evidence-upload-pipeline` as a wrapper that exists even before upload starts so QA can verify the four stages without simulating an upload. NOT a blocker.
Minor selector-doc gap: review_request listed 'Legal holds' but actual nav label is 'Legal Hold'. Test passes — just calling out for next-iteration consistency in docs.
No other findings — every Phase 3.9 acceptance criterion verified.
test_credentials: super_admin: register POST /api/v1/auth/register with TestPass123!, promote in mongo via db.identity_users.updateOne({email}, {$set:{roles:['super_admin'], role:'super_admin'}, $inc:{version:1}}), re-login, set localStorage.lv_session_token = access_token before visiting /evidence. Token written to /tmp/sa_token.txt during this run for reproducibility.
seed_data_creation: Created one ephemeral super_admin user (sa_<random>@test.com / TestPass123!) for E2E; promoted via Mongo identity_users. No business data was seeded — existing 1600+ evidence.timeline events were used to verify projections rebuild.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3.9 is constitutional-clean. SDK pinned to v1.5.0+sdk.1 via /app/frontend/src/sdk/meta.ts; any change to OpenAPI or to /pages/evidence/*.jsx must keep tests/test_sdk_consistency.py green. The 7 SDK gates enforce: (1) meta matches /app/contracts/v1/sdk/compatibility.json, (2) every /api/v1/* path used by the SDK exists in frozen OpenAPI, (3) SDK exposes all 4 Phase 3.8 admin endpoints, (4) SDK exposes all evidence projection endpoints, (5+6) zero direct REST calls and zero lib/api imports inside pages/evidence/, (7) compatibility manifest is at or above v1.5.0. Six pre-existing legacy failures (tests/backend_test.py, tests/test_concurrency.py, tests/test_tenant_isolation.py, tests/test_worker_reports.py) are PRE-EXISTING and out of constitutional DDD scope — do not flag.
